database.notes: Instabot-Pro ships the JSON backend only.

whiteListMode.notes: If enabled, only IDs in whiteListIds can use the bot.

whiteListModeThread.notes: If enabled, only threads in whiteListThreadIds can use the bot.

noPrefix.notes: true = only bot admins can use commands without prefix | false = everyone must use prefix

reactUnsend.notes: If enable = true, bot will unsend any message reacted with these emojis. If onlyAdmin = true, only adminBot IDs can trigger it. skipPollUnderRealtime: when true the reaction watcher stops its 5s round-robin thread-detail poll while its realtime MQTT push is connected. The push carries a reaction as a `/items/<iid>/reactions/likes/<reactor>` patch (verified live), so the poll is redundant then - and it was a big part of the inbox 429 throttle. The watcher resumes polling automatically whenever the push is down.

credentials.notes: 'disabled' keeps the googleapis-backed utils loadable without OAuth credentials; fill these in to enable Google Drive features.

instagramAccount.notes: Paste the browser cookie JSON (or the sessionid) here; see README.md. account.txt takes precedence when present. sessionParams (optional) is the JSON object of web params (__dyn/__csr/__hs/...) used to skip the in-container browser harvest; INSTAGRAM_SESSION_PARAMS overrides it.

notesPollInterval: How often (ms) the bot polls the Instagram DM inbox. Instagram has no reliable DM push, so a reply waits up to this long. 15000 is the library's documented safe floor; polling faster (the old 2000) trips Instagram's 429 throttle, which is exactly what a datacenter IP like Render's does. Raise it further if 429s persist; a residential proxy lets you lower it.
notesRealtime: false (default) = poll the inbox, the guaranteed delivery path. true = also subscribe to Instagram's MQTT message-sync push so a DM arrives in ~1s. Only enable it if you have confirmed inbound DMs actually arrive on the push from your host (some datacenter IPs connect+subscribe but receive nothing, which leaves the bot deaf); the package falls back to polling automatically if the broker cannot be reached.
notesProxy: Route all Instagram HTTP traffic through a proxy, e.g. "http://user:pass@host:port" or {"https":"http://...","http":"http://..."}. Strongly recommended on a VPS: a data-centre IP is the main reason Instagram logs the session out or suspends it. Use a residential or mobile proxy.
notesTypingIndicator: true = show 'is typing...' before every reply (more human-like, adds visible delay) | false = reply instantly, no typing shown

optionsFca.notes: GoatBot-Pro style FCA options; the Instagram adapter forwards the fields it supports and no-ops the rest.
